title: Defensive-event qualification gates
declared_note: Committed before the qualification harness was run against any corpus beyond the 324-cell post-Phase-4 sample already reported in the Phase 4 addendum. Nothing in this file may be revised in response to a Phase 5A or Phase 5B result; a failing gate is a finding, not a prompt to retune.

scope.note: Phase 5A is measurement only. No score, weight, Ruleset identity, agent, or default is altered. Rewarding the event is Phase 5B and is gated on this phase passing.

event_definition.statement: An entrant loses at least THRESHOLD of its own core cells to opponent writes within a single tick, and still owns at least 1 core cell at that tick's capture check.
event_definition.threshold_status: PROVISIONAL - discovered from the 324-cell post-Phase-4 sample. May be revised by this phase's own characterization, but only before Phase 5B runs, and never in response to a scoring outcome.
event_definition.survival_clause: still owns >= 1 core cell at the tick's capture check

mechanical_prediction.claim: Every agent in the frozen v2-baseline population advances by a fixed stride strictly greater than CORE_SIZE (claimer 101, core_defender/reactive_core_defender 131, core_seeker 149, core_tracker 157, hunter dense 173), and receives instr_per_tick actions per tick. Consecutive writes are therefore at least one stride apart, so a purely sweeping opponent can land at most ONE write inside any given 8-cell core window per tick.
mechanical_prediction.consequence: Pure sweeping can cost a victim at most (entrant_count - 1) core cells in a single tick: 2 at N=3, 1 at N=2. Any single-tick loss above that ceiling implies at least one opponent wrote a contiguous run into the core -- i.e. a deliberate assault burst.
mechanical_prediction.falsifiable_by: Observing any tick in which one single opponent takes >= 2 cells of a victim's core while that opponent is not executing a contiguous assault burst, or any sweeper-only tick exceeding the (entrant_count - 1) ceiling.
mechanical_prediction.why_it_matters: If it holds, the threshold is not a curve fitted to this corpus; it is grounded in the population's write geometry, and 3 is the mechanical floor at N=3 with 4 carrying one cell of margin.

Q1_selectivity_search.statement: Across the full default-condition group corpus (11 rosters x 54 cells = 594), search-agent event rate is <= 2% of appearances.

Q2_selectivity_defense.statement: Across the same corpus, defense-agent event rate is >= 25% of appearances.

Q3_threshold_margin.statement: The maximum single-tick own-core loss suffered by any search agent stays <= 2, i.e. two cells below the threshold of 4.
Q3_threshold_margin.note: A searcher reaching 3 cuts the margin to one cell and requires the threshold to be re-derived and re-declared before Phase 5B.

Q4_burst_attribution.statement: At least 90% of defense events are classified as caused by a contiguous assault burst, defined deterministically as: at least one single opponent took >= 2 of the victim's core cells in that tick. The complement (every opponent took exactly 1) is coincidental sweeping.
Q4_burst_attribution.note: The mechanical prediction implies this should be 100% at N=3, because 2 opponents each limited to 1 cell cannot reach 4. Measured rather than assumed.

Q5_frequency_discipline.statement: Median qualifying ticks per event-bearing match <= 3.

cap_trigger.statement: If the 95th percentile of qualifying ticks per event-bearing match exceeds 10, a per-match event cap is REQUIRED before Phase 5B and must be declared before 5B runs.

Q6_determinism.statement: 100% of events reproduce identically across two independent reconstruction passes over the committed replays.

C1_threshold_sensitivity.statement: Report selectivity and event counts at thresholds 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, and state at which thresholds the mechanical interpretation (loss above the sweeper ceiling implies a burst) still holds.
C1_threshold_sensitivity.disclosure_trigger: If threshold 4's selectivity is not materially better than 3 and 5, say so; do not present 4 as uniquely justified when neighbours behave identically.

C2_seat_creation_vs_survival.statement: Decompose seat effects into event CREATION and event SURVIVAL: P(burst incursion >= threshold occurs | victim seat) versus P(victim survives the tick | such an incursion occurred, victim seat). These are different mechanisms -- being found and burst is attacker-driven; same-tick reclaim depends on acting after the attacker within the tick.
C2_seat_creation_vs_survival.disclosure_trigger: If the SURVIVAL conditional varies by more than 25 percentage points across seats, the event is substantially a scheduler-order artifact and must be reported as such, with Phase 5B required to show exhaustive seat permutation neutralizes it.

C3_density_robustness.statement: Re-measure Q1/Q2/Q3 at additional Phase 1 density conditions spanning the arena/budget range.
C3_density_robustness.disclosure_trigger: If selectivity holds only at a4096_b8, the threshold is a property of one condition rather than of the mechanic, and Phase 5B must not proceed on the default condition alone.

C4_pairwise_meaning.statement: Measure on the 3 pairwise controls and state the event's 1v1 meaning explicitly. At N=2 the sweeper ceiling is 1, so any >= 2 single-tick loss already implies a burst; and losing the whole core ends the match outright.
C4_pairwise_meaning.disclosure_trigger: Do not assume group semantics transfer to 1v1; state the difference.

decision_rule.pass: All blocking gates Q1-Q6 satisfied, and every C1-C4 characterization measured and reported.
decision_rule.revise: A blocking gate fails in a way the characterization shows is a threshold-choice artifact: re-derive the threshold within Phase 5A, re-declare it in this file's successor, and re-run. Permitted at most once, and never after any Phase 5B scoring outcome has been examined.
decision_rule.fail: A blocking gate fails structurally -- the event cannot be made selective, or is farmable without a cap that destroys its meaning, or is a scheduler artifact. Phase 5A then reports a null result and Phase 5B does not run.
decision_rule.null_is_valid: Stopping at Phase 5A with a null result is a complete, reportable outcome, exactly as the Phase 2 locality and Phase 4 defense-lever nulls were.

population.note: hunter is expansion per Phase 0 Sec 10.3's correction of the Beta2 archetype table.

corpus.execution: none - Phase 5A reconstructs from committed artifacts only
